title: pm-dispatch: the qa#1 Routine seat owns the QA routines and record close; qa-rollup reads page 2 on the /repos path
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X9MWHhG8KycPJJjaBkrv3xH)_

Fixes #31305

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:新增 `qa#1` 席位章程 `lanes/qa.md`(每周回归四张记录、发版后 npm 冒烟、收口关卡与 supersede、每周跑欠测清单;不派开发、不改产品代码);`lanes/skills.md` 与 checklist-test §6 把两条例行的负责人统一写成 `qa#1`,§5 补一行「收口完成即由 QA 席关记录」;`qa` 加进座位签名与信箱的席位词;`qa-rollup.mjs` 第 2 页改走 `/repos/...` 路径。
- 为什么改:你选了 A(「同意 新设 qa#1」)。过去两条例行一边写「归 skills 席」一边写「派发的 PM 会话建」,结果没人跑;记录收口后没人关;`qa-rollup.mjs` 在云席读到第 2 页就 403。
- 风险与回滚:只动内部指令文本与 PM/QA 脚本,不发布(skip-changeset)。回滚即 revert;不启动任何 routine。
- 先看:`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/qa.md` 全文;`.claude/skills/checklist-test/SKILL.md` §5 新增的「关闭」段与 §6 首段;`scripts/qa/qa-rollup.mjs` 的 `fetchRunRecords`。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/qa/qa-rollup.mjs --self-test`,预期 `✓ … 82 assertions`;云席里 `NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1 node scripts/qa/qa-rollup.mjs --json`,预期 `apiCalls: 2`、180 条记录,不再 403。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地(Tier S,席内契约复审 PASS 后入队);合并后请在 Routines UI 为 `qa#1` 建每周 routine。

## What changes

- **New `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/qa.md`** (29 lines): the `qa#N` role seat, a Routine seat the maintainer creates in the Routines UI with a weekly fire, plus one round after each release. Each round: `retest-owed.mjs` first (its owed ids scope the `owed:weekly` record), the four weekly records of checklist-test §6, the post-release `smoke:npm-VERSION` record, close-out of every record per §5, close `completed` once close-out is complete, supersede per §5, `qa-rollup.mjs` at round end for the open-record count, and a spend line per round. Boundaries: no `os-dev`, no product code, no PR; a §3 checklist revision is filed as a card with the item's lane like an assertion defect; defect cards go to triage; security findings only through `security-findings.md`; waves stay manual; skill and RUNNER text stays with `domain:skills`. First act once started: `retest-owed.mjs`, then the first `owed:weekly` record.
- **Text owed item 1** (one owner): `lanes/skills.md` 「QA 管理循环执行归本席」 now names `qa#1` (`qa.md`) as the executor and keeps the skills seat on the text; checklist-test §6 replaces "the dispatching PM session builds the routines" with: the two routines belong to `qa#1`, and the maintainer builds its routine.
- **Text owed item 2**: `lanes/skills.md` now says waves are manual and the two checklist-test §6 routines run on schedule, by `qa#1`, and are not waves.
- **Text owed item 3**: checklist-test §5 gains a 「关闭」 paragraph before the Supersede protocol: close-out complete means the QA seat closes the record `completed` that round with a pointer to the close-out comment; residuals stay on their own cards; retests are owed through `retest-owed.mjs`; a record is not held open for fixes.
- **Item 4**: `scripts/qa/qa-rollup.mjs` `fetchRunRecords` now carries the `rel="next"` link's query onto the `/repos/OWNER/REPO/...` path it started from (`onPathOf`), instead of following the numeric `/repositories/ID/...` link the egress proxy refuses. `onPathOf` moves from `retest-owed.mjs` into `qa-rollup.mjs` (which `retest-owed.mjs` already imports from), so the two tools share one spelling. `fetchRunRecords` is exported and takes a `fetchImpl` seam for the self-test. `docs/qa/platform-checklist/RUNNER.md`'s note on the page-2 failure is rewritten to the fixed behaviour.
- **Rosters the new seat moves** (pin moves, no new gate, label or protocol key):
  - the seat lane-word grammar: `qa` joins `SEAT_BARE_LANES` (`scripts/pm/mailbox-open.mjs`, its prose and its self-test pins) and the signature alternation `SIGNATURE_LANE_SOURCE` (`scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs`). Without it a `qa#1 · ACCOUNT · SESSION` signature is refused by `post-stamped.mjs` and `issue-create.mjs`, so the seat could not write a record. `fleet-roster.mjs`'s self-test holds the two lists equal and passes unchanged. This follows the `review#N` and `security#N` seats.
  - `project-forms.md`: `qa` joins the seat-word list (`pm-dispatch qa`).
  - `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`: a `CEILINGS` row for `lanes/qa.md` (29, headroom 0, a new file) and its `MAX_TABLE_ROW_BYTES` row (0); the `laneRosterVerdict` census requires both.

## Ratchet raise

`.claude/skills/checklist-test/SKILL.md` ceiling 276 → 279. Ruling of record: comment 6715420603 (maintainer letter A, 「同意 新设 qa#1」), whose workload orders the three text fixes and `lanes/qa.md`. Measured line delta **+3** (276 → 279: the two-line 「关闭」 paragraph and its paragraph break; the §6 rewrite is 0 lines). The row moves by exactly +3. `lanes/skills.md` stays at 32 lines (ceiling 33), `project-forms.md` at 59; `lanes/qa.md` is a new row at its landed count.

## Tests

- `node scripts/qa/qa-rollup.mjs --self-test`: `✓ qa-rollup --self-test: 82 assertions over 5 canonical shapes and 16 retired ones` (new battery 「a listing stays on the repository path」, 4 cases, floor 11 → 12 batteries). The battery feeds a fake fetch whose page 1 carries GitHub's real next-link shape naming `/repositories/42/...`, and which answers that path 403 the way the proxy does.
- **Ablation** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, on committed `390c0a0e`): `url = next ? onPathOf(url, next[1]) : null;` → `url = next ? next[1] : null; // ABL` (injected count 1, anchor count 0). Self-test exit 1 with 3 failures: 「page 2 is read, not refused: GitHub API 403 Forbidden for …/repositories/42/…」, 「both pages land, in order」, 「the next page is asked on the /repos path, never /repositories/ID」. Restored: blob `b7cb4cd1e861` == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty; self-test green again.
- `node scripts/qa/retest-owed.mjs --self-test`: `✓ 57 assertions in 9 batteries` (its `onPathOf` battery now exercises the moved helper).
- `--self-test` exit 0: `mailbox-open` (87 cases), `fleet-roster` (115), `check-half-states` (5253), `post-stamped` (753), `record-recognisers` (375), `check-skill-line-ratchet` (164); `node scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` exit 0.
- **Real runs in a cloud container, read-only** (`NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1`, on `390c0a0e`):
  - `qa-rollup.mjs --json`: exit 0, `apiCalls: 2`, corpus 180 (open 0, closed 180, parsed 156, unparseable 24).
  - Control leg, `qa-rollup.mjs` from `origin/main` `cba7d8ae`: exit 1, `GitHub API 403 Forbidden for https://api.github.com/repositories/1136691870/issues?labels=qa-run&state=all&per_page=100&after=…&page=2`.
  - `retest-owed.mjs --json`: exit 0, `apiCalls: 260`, 180 records, 21,762 issues and PRs scanned, 356 fix cards, 40 subject shas all resolved; owed 73, re-judged 120, unknown 0, not landed 6, not read 55.

## Acceptance notes

- Premise correction on item 4: `retest-owed.mjs` already followed next links on the `/repos` path (`onPathOf`), so only `qa-rollup.mjs` failed on page 2; the card's evaluation thread said the same. The fix reuses that helper rather than rebuilding a `page=N` URL: GitHub's next link for this listing carries both an `after=` cursor and `page=2`, and carrying its whole query keeps both.
- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md`'s 域车道 table is not changed. Its `security` · `review` row is 315 bytes against the 341-byte `MAX_TABLE_ROW_BYTES` pin; naming `qa` there costs about 45 bytes, which needs a ruled raise or cuts to other rows' text. The triage and director role seats are not in that table either; `project-forms.md`'s seat-word list is where a summons word is read.
- Landing tier: `check-governed-merges.mjs --branch` answers **Tier S** (all four governed paths are under `.claude/**`), not Tier H as the card's ruling text expected. Landing is the owning seat's, after an in-seat `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review PASS on the current head and green checks.
- The 15 `qa-run` closes and #29560 were triage's and are not in this PR. The real run above reads 0 open `qa-run` records.

## Verification

Gate list from `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on the real diff (57 commands), run on `390c0a0e`: all 57 exit 0; `dispatch-gates --ran` reconciliation 57 derived, 57 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. `check:doc-formula-expressions` first answered exit 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: formula and lint `dist/` absent in a fresh worktree) and exit 0 after `turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/formula --filter=@objectstack/lint` under `os-verify-lock.sh`.

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --tier`: no path-derived model mandate. `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --branch claude/project-thread-6n4eey`: GOVERNED, Tier S, `.claude/**` ×4; 160 changed lines (+118 / −42), under 3000.

Scoped lint: `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config` over the five edited scripts, exit 0.
